title.en: Volume 171 Biographies 59: Wang Ji, Xu Youzhen, Yang Shan, Wang Yue

translations.literal: Wang Ji
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji

translations.idiomatic: (Sun Jin)]〉

translations.literal: Xu Youzhen and Yang Shan
translations.idiomatic: Xu Youzhen and Yang Shan

translations.idiomatic: (Li Shi, Zhao Rong, Huo Xuan, and Shen Gu)]〉

sentences.zh: 王越

translations.literal: Wang Yue
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yue

sentences.zh: 王驥，字尚德，束鹿人。

translations.literal: Wang Ji, styled Shangde, was a native of Shulu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji, courtesy name Shangde, came from Shulu.

sentences.zh: 長身偉幹，便騎射，剛毅有膽，曉暢戎略。

translations.literal: Tall in stature and broad in build, skilled at horsemanship and archery, resolute and bold, and well versed in military strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He was tall and powerfully built, adept at riding and archery, firm of character and courageous, and thoroughly knowledgeable in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 中永樂四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fourth year of the Yongle reign.
translations.idiomatic: He placed among the metropolitan graduates in Yongle 4 (1406).

sentences.zh: 為兵科給事中，使山西，奏免鹽池逋課二十余萬，尋遷山西按察司副使。

translations.literal: He served as supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs, was dispatched to Shanxi, memorialized the remission of more than two hundred thousand in overdue salt-pond levies, and soon afterward was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Shanxi Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed a supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs, he was sent to Shanxi and successfully petitioned for the remission of over two hundred thousand in delinquent salt-pond taxes; he was soon promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Shanxi Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年入為順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi, he entered the capital as Prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi 1 (1425), he was recalled to serve as Prefect of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，擢兵部右侍郎，代顧佐署都察院。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xuande reign, he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and, acting for Gu Zuo, administered the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuande reign, he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and, standing in for Gu Zuo, took charge of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 久之，署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: After some time, he served as acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: After a time, he was appointed acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 九年命為真。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed to the post in full capacity.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, he received the permanent appointment.

sentences.zh: 俄阿臺復入寇。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, Atai again invaded.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Atai raided the frontier once more.

sentences.zh: 帝以任禮為平羌將軍，蔣貴、趙安為副，驥督軍。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Ren Li General Who Pacifies the Qiang, with Jiang Gui and Zhao An as deputies, and Ji supervised the army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor named Ren Li General Who Pacifies the Qiang, with Jiang Gui and Zhao An as his deputies, while Ji served as overall commander.

sentences.zh: 三年春，偕諸將出塞，以貴為前鋒，而自與任禮帥大軍後繼，與貴約曰：「不捷，無相見也。」

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, he marched beyond the frontier with the other generals, making Gui the vanguard while he and Ren Li led the main force in support; he made a pact with Gui, saying: "If you do not prevail, we shall not meet again.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year, he led the generals out beyond the frontier, placing Gui in the vanguard while he and Ren Li followed with the main army. He told Gui, "If you do not win, we are not to meet again.

sentences.zh: 貴擊敵石城，敵走兀魯乃。

translations.literal: Gui struck the enemy at Shicheng, and the enemy fled to Wulunai.
translations.idiomatic: Gui attacked the enemy at Shicheng, and they retreated toward Wulunai.

sentences.zh: 貴帥輕騎二千五百人出鎮夷，間道兼行，三日夜及之。

translations.literal: Gui led twenty-five hundred light cavalry out from Zhenyi, traveling by hidden routes day and night, and caught up with them in three days.
translations.idiomatic: Gui took twenty-five hundred light cavalry from Zhenyi, marched by concealed routes without rest, and overtook the enemy in three days and nights.

sentences.zh: 擒左丞脫羅，斬首三百余，獲金銀印各一，駝馬兵甲千計。

translations.literal: He captured the Left Chancellor Tuoluo, beheaded more than three hundred men, seized one gold seal and one silver seal, and took more than a thousand camels, horses, weapons, and suits of armor.
translations.idiomatic: He captured the Left Chancellor Tuoluo, took more than three hundred heads, seized one gold and one silver seal, and captured over a thousand camels, horses, weapons, and suits of armor.

sentences.zh: 驥與禮自梧桐林至亦集乃，擒樞密、同知、僉院十五人，萬戶二人。

translations.literal: Ji and Li advanced from Wutonglin to Yijinai, capturing fifteen officials of the ranks of Privy Councilor, Vice Commissioner, and Assistant Commissioner, and two commanders of ten-thousand-household units.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Li marched from Wutonglin to Yijinai, capturing fifteen officials—including privy councilors, vice commissioners, and assistant commissioners—and two commanders of ten-thousand-household units.

sentences.zh: 降其部落，窮進至黑泉。

translations.literal: They reduced the enemy tribes to submission and pressed on in pursuit as far as Heiquan.
translations.idiomatic: They brought the enemy tribes to submission and pursued the fleeing forces all the way to Heiquan.

sentences.zh: 而趙安等出昌寧，至刁力溝，亦擒右丞、達魯花赤三十人。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Zhao An and others set out from Changning, reached Diaoligou, and also captured thirty Right Chancellors and darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Zhao An and his column marched from Changning to Diaoligou, where they captured thirty right chancellors and darughachi.

sentences.zh: 分道夾擊，轉戰千餘里，朵兒只伯遠遁。

translations.literal: They attacked from separate routes in a pincer movement, fighting over more than a thousand li, and Duorizhibo fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: Striking from separate routes in a pincer attack, they fought across more than a thousand li until Duorizhibo fled into the distance.

sentences.zh: 論功，貴、禮皆封伯，而驥兼大理卿，支二俸。

translations.literal: When merits were assessed, Gui and Li were both enfeoffed as earls, while Ji was additionally appointed Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and received two salaries.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards were distributed, Gui and Li were both enfeoffed as earls, while Ji was also made Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and granted two salaries.

sentences.zh: 尋召還，理部事。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was recalled and managed the affairs of his ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to the capital to resume the duties of his ministry.

sentences.zh: 久之，麓川之役起。

translations.literal: After some time, the Luchuan campaign began.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, the Luchuan campaign was launched.

sentences.zh: 麓川宣慰使思任發叛，數敗王師。

translations.literal: Si Renfa, Pacification Commissioner of Luchuan, rebelled and repeatedly defeated the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa, the Pacification Commissioner of Luchuan, rebelled and repeatedly routed the imperial forces.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐晟討之，不利，道卒。

translations.literal: Duke Mu Sheng of Qian led a punitive expedition against him but met with no success and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mu Sheng of Qian marched against him but fared poorly and died en route.

sentences.zh: 以沐昂代。

translations.literal: Mu Ang was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ang was appointed to replace him.

sentences.zh: 昂條上攻取策，征兵十二萬人。

translations.literal: Ang submitted a detailed plan for a campaign of conquest and raised an army of one hundred twenty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Ang submitted a detailed plan for a conquest and raised an army of one hundred twenty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 中官王振方用事，喜功名，以驥可屬，思大舉。

translations.literal: The eunuch Wang Zhen was then in power, eager for military glory; he considered Ji a man who could be entrusted with the task and wished to launch a major campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Wang Zhen was then in power and eager for military glory; believing Ji could be entrusted with the command, he wanted to launch a major expedition.

sentences.zh: 驥亦欲自效。

translations.literal: Ji also wished to prove himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, for his part, was eager to distinguish himself.

sentences.zh: 六年正月遂拜蔣貴平蠻將軍，李安、劉聚為副，而驥總督軍務，大發東南諸道兵十五萬討之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, Jiang Gui was appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Li An and Liu Ju as deputies, while Ji was made overall commander of military affairs; one hundred fifty thousand troops were mobilized from the southeastern circuits to suppress the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, Jiang Gui was appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Li An and Liu Ju as his deputies, while Ji was made overall commander; one hundred fifty thousand troops from the southeastern circuits were mobilized for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎何文淵、侍講劉球先後疏諫，不納。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and Hanlin Reader Liu Qiu successively submitted memorials in remonstrance, but their advice was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and Hanlin Reader Liu Qiu submitted successive memorials urging restraint, but the court would not listen.

sentences.zh: 瀕行，賜驥、貴金兜鍪、細鎧、蟒繡緋衣、朱弓矢。

translations.literal: On the eve of departure, Ji and Gui were granted golden helmets, fine armor, python-embroidered scarlet robes, and vermilion bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Before they set out, Ji and Gui were presented with golden helmets, fine armor, python-embroidered scarlet robes, and vermilion bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 驥請得以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Ji requested authority to act at his own discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Ji asked for discretionary authority to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 馳傳至雲南，部署諸將，遣參將冉保由東路趨孟定，大軍由中路至騰沖，分道夾擊。

translations.literal: Traveling by relay post, he reached Yunnan, deployed the generals, sent Assistant Commander Ran Bao by the eastern route toward Mengding, and led the main army by the central route to Tengchong, attacking from separate directions in a pincer movement.
translations.idiomatic: He rode by relay post to Yunnan, deployed his generals, sent Assistant Commander Ran Bao east toward Mengding, and led the main force along the central route to Tengchong, striking from two directions.

sentences.zh: 是年十一月，與貴以二萬人趨上江，圍其寨，五日不下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of that year, he and Gui advanced on Shangjiang with twenty thousand men, besieged the enemy stockade, and failed to take it in five days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of that year, he and Gui marched on Shangjiang with twenty thousand men and besieged an enemy stockade, but could not reduce it in five days.

sentences.zh: 會大風，縱火焚柵，拔之，斬首五萬余級。

translations.literal: When a strong wind arose, they set fire to the palisades, captured the position, and beheaded more than fifty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: A strong wind came up, and they set the palisades ablaze, stormed the position, and took more than fifty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 進自夾象石，渡下江，通高黎貢山道。

translations.literal: They advanced from Jiaxiangshi, crossed the Xiajiang, and opened the route through the Gaoligong Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced from Jiaxiangshi, crossed the Xiajiang, and opened the route through the Gaoligong Mountains.

sentences.zh: 閏月至騰沖，長驅抵杉木籠山。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month they reached Tengchong and drove straight on to Shanmulong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month they reached Tengchong and pressed forward to Shanmulong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊乘高據險，築七壘相救。

translations.literal: The rebels held the heights and difficult terrain, building seven fortified camps to support one another.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the high ground and difficult terrain, building seven fortified camps to reinforce one another.

sentences.zh: 驥遣參將宮聚、副將劉聚分左右翼緣嶺上，而自將中軍奮擊之，賊大潰，乘勝至馬鞍山。

translations.literal: Ji sent Assistant Commander Gong Ju and Vice Commander Liu Ju to lead the left and right wings along the ridges, while he personally commanded the center in a fierce assault; the rebels were routed in great disorder, and the army pressed the victory to Ma'anshan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji sent Assistant Commander Gong Ju and Vice Commander Liu Ju to lead the left and right wings along the ridges, while he personally led the center in a fierce assault; the rebels broke and fled, and the army pursued them to Ma'anshan.

sentences.zh: 逾月，抵賊巢。

translations.literal: After more than a month, they reached the rebel stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month, they reached the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 山陡絕，深塹環之。

translations.literal: The mountain was steep and precipitous, encircled by deep moats.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain rose steep and sheer, ringed by deep trenches.

sentences.zh: 東南面江，壁立不可上。

translations.literal: On the southeast it faced the river, with cliffs rising sheer and impassable.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast it faced the river, where cliffs rose sheer and could not be climbed.

sentences.zh: 驥遣前軍覘賊，敗其伏兵。

translations.literal: Ji sent the vanguard to reconnoiter the enemy and defeated their ambush force.
translations.idiomatic: Ji sent the vanguard to scout the enemy and routed their ambush.

sentences.zh: 賊更自間道立柵馬鞍山，出大軍後。

translations.literal: The rebels then built a stockade at Ma'anshan by a hidden route and emerged behind the main army.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then built a stockade at Ma'anshan by a hidden route and appeared in the rear of the main army.

sentences.zh: 驥戒軍中無動，而令都指揮方瑛以六千人突賊寨，斬首數百，復誘敗其象陣。

translations.literal: Ji ordered the army to hold its position, then sent Commander Fang Ying with six thousand men to storm the rebel stockade, beheading several hundred, and afterward lured and defeated their elephant formation.
translations.idiomatic: Ji ordered the army to hold steady, then sent Commander Fang Ying with six thousand men to storm the rebel stockade, taking several hundred heads, and afterward lured and broke their elephant formation.

sentences.zh: 會東路軍冉保等已合木邦、車裏、大侯諸土軍，破烏木弄、戛邦諸寨。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the eastern force under Ran Bao and others had joined with the native troops of Mubang, Cheli, and Dahou and had captured the stockades of Wumunong, Jiabang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Ran Bao's eastern column had joined with the native forces of Mubang, Cheli, and Dahou and had overrun the stockades at Wumunong, Jiabang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 遣別將守西峨渡，防賊軼，刻期與大軍會。

translations.literal: He sent a separate commander to hold Xi'e Ford, guard against enemy raids, and join the main army at the appointed time.
translations.idiomatic: He posted a separate commander at Xi'e Ford to guard against enemy raids and to rendezvous with the main army on schedule.

sentences.zh: 驥乃督諸將環攻其七門，積薪縱火。

translations.literal: Ji then directed the generals to attack all seven gates in a surrounding assault, heaping firewood and setting it ablaze.
translations.idiomatic: Ji then ordered the generals to assault all seven gates in a ring attack, piling firewood and setting it ablaze.

sentences.zh: 風大作，賊焚死無算，溺江死者數萬人。

translations.literal: The wind rose violently; countless rebels were burned to death, and tens of thousands drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: A fierce wind blew up; countless rebels were burned alive, and tens of thousands drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 思任發攜二子走孟養。

translations.literal: Si Renfa fled to Mengyang with his two sons.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa fled to Mengyang with his two sons.

sentences.zh: 獲其虎符、金牌、宣慰司印及所掠騰沖諸衛所印章三十有奇。

translations.literal: They captured his tiger tally, gold tablet, Pacification Commission seal, and more than thirty seals of the guard units of Tengchong that he had plundered.
translations.idiomatic: They seized his tiger tally, gold tablet, Pacification Commission seal, and more than thirty seals of the guard units around Tengchong that he had looted.

sentences.zh: 犁其巢穴，留兵守之而還。

translations.literal: They razed the rebel stronghold, left troops to garrison it, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They razed the rebel stronghold, left a garrison behind, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年四月遣偏師討維摩土司韋郎羅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year, he dispatched a detached force to suppress Wei Langluo, native chieftain of Weimo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the following year, he sent a detached column against Wei Langluo, the native chieftain of Weimo.

sentences.zh: 郎羅走安南，俘其妻子。

translations.literal: Langluo fled to Annam, and his wife and children were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Langluo fled to Annam, and his wife and children were taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 傳檄安南，縛之以獻。

translations.literal: A proclamation was sent to Annam, and Langluo was bound and presented as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: A proclamation was sent to Annam, and Langluo was bound and delivered to the court.

sentences.zh: 五月，師還。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the army returned.

sentences.zh: 帝遣戶部侍郎王質賫羊酒迎勞，賜宴奉天門。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Zhi with sheep and wine to welcome and reward the troops, and granted them a banquet at Fengtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Zhi with sheep and wine to welcome the returning army and granted them a banquet at Fengtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 封推誠宣力武臣、特進榮祿大夫、上柱國、靖遠伯，歲祿千二百石，世襲指揮同知，賜貂蟬冠玉帶。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as a meritorious military subject who promotes sincerity and displays strength, given the extraordinary rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, made Upper Pillar of the State, and created Earl of Jingyuan with an annual stipend of one thousand two hundred shi, hereditary as Assistant Commander, and granted a cicada cap and jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Earl of Jingyuan with the titles of meritorious military subject, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Upper Pillar of the State, granted an annual stipend of one thousand two hundred shi and hereditary rank as Assistant Commander, and presented with a cicada cap and jade belt.

sentences.zh: 貴進侯，劉聚等遷賞有差。

translations.literal: Gui was promoted to marquis, and Liu Ju and others received promotions and rewards according to their merits.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was promoted to marquis, and Liu Ju and the others were promoted and rewarded according to their merits.

sentences.zh: 從征少卿李蕡，郎中侯琎、楊寧皆擢侍郎，士卒賜予加等。

translations.literal: Li Fan, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Hou Jin and Yang Ning, Directors; all received promotions to vice minister, and the soldiers were granted extra rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Directors Hou Jin and Yang Ning were all promoted to vice minister, while the soldiers received enhanced rewards.

sentences.zh: 府庫為竭。

translations.literal: The state treasuries were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The state treasuries were drained.

sentences.zh: 思任發之竄緬甸也，其子思機發復帥余眾居者藍，乞入朝謝罪。

translations.literal: When Si Renfa fled into Burma, his son Si Jifa again led the remaining forces to occupy Zhelan and petitioned to come to court to beg forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: After Si Renfa fled into Burma, his son Si Jifa rallied the remaining forces at Zhelan and petitioned to come to court and beg forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 廷議因而撫之，王振不可。

translations.literal: The court debated accepting this and offering pacification, but Wang Zhen would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated accepting the offer and extending pacification, but Wang Zhen would not hear of it.

sentences.zh: 是年八月復命驥總督雲南軍務，帥參將冉保、毛福壽以往。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year, Ji was again appointed overall commander of Yunnan military affairs and led Assistant Commanders Ran Bao and Mao Fushou on the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year, Ji was again appointed overall commander of Yunnan military affairs and marched with Assistant Commanders Ran Bao and Mao Fushou.

sentences.zh: 未至而思機發遣弟招賽入貢，緬甸亦奏獲思任發，要麓川地。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, Si Jifa sent his younger brother Zhaosai to present tribute, and Burma also reported that it had captured Si Renfa and demanded Luchuan territory in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived, Si Jifa sent his younger brother Zhaosai to present tribute, while Burma reported that it had captured Si Renfa and demanded Luchuan territory in return.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不納其貢，且敕驥圖緬甸，驥因請濟師。

translations.literal: The court did not accept the tribute and also ordered Ji to move against Burma; Ji thereupon requested reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused the tribute and ordered Ji to move against Burma; Ji then requested reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 八年五月復命蔣貴為平蠻將軍，調土兵五萬往，發卒轉餉五十萬人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, Jiang Gui was again appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians; fifty thousand native troops were mobilized for the campaign, and five hundred thousand men were conscripted to transport supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year, Jiang Gui was again appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians; fifty thousand native troops were mobilized, and five hundred thousand men were drafted to transport supplies.

sentences.zh: 驥初檄緬甸送思任發。

translations.literal: At first Ji issued a summons to Burma to deliver Si Renfa.
translations.idiomatic: Ji first issued a summons demanding that Burma hand over Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 緬人陽聽命，持兩端。

translations.literal: The Burmese outwardly obeyed but kept to a double game.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese feigned compliance while playing both sides.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，大軍逼緬甸，緬人以樓船載思任發覘官軍，而潛以他舟載之歸。

translations.literal: That winter, as the main army pressed Burma, the Burmese put Si Renfa aboard a tower ship to show the imperial forces, while secretly transporting him back on another vessel.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, as the main army closed on Burma, the Burmese displayed Si Renfa on a tower ship for the imperial forces to see while secretly sending him back on another boat.

sentences.zh: 驥知緬人資木邦水利為唇齒，且慮思機發將以獻其父故仇之，故終不肯獻思任發。

translations.literal: Ji knew that the Burmese relied on Mubang's waterways as closely linked as lips and teeth, and also feared that Si Jifa would treat the surrender of his father as a grievous offense; therefore they ultimately refused to hand over Si Renfa.
translations.idiomatic: Ji understood that the Burmese depended on Mubang's waterways as closely as lips and teeth, and that they feared Si Jifa would regard the surrender of his father as an unforgivable betrayal; for these reasons they ultimately refused to hand over Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 驥乃趨者藍，破思機發巢，得其妻子部落，而思機發獨脫去。

translations.literal: Ji then pressed on to Zhelan, destroyed Si Jifa's stronghold, and captured his wife, children, and tribes, but Si Jifa alone escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Ji then marched on Zhelan, destroyed Si Jifa's stronghold, and captured his wife, children, and followers, but Si Jifa himself escaped.

sentences.zh: 明年召還，加祿三百石，命與都御史陳鎰巡延綏、寧夏、甘肅諸邊。

translations.literal: The following year he was recalled, granted an additional stipend of three hundred shi, and ordered with Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi to inspect the frontier regions of Yan-sui, Ningxia, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was recalled, granted an additional stipend of three hundred shi, and ordered to inspect the frontier regions of Yan-sui, Ningxia, and Gansu together with Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi.

sentences.zh: 初，寧夏備邊軍，半歲一更。

translations.literal: At first, the frontier garrison troops in Ningxia were rotated every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Originally, the frontier garrison troops in Ningxia were rotated every six months.

sentences.zh: 後邊事亟，三年乃更。

translations.literal: Later, as frontier affairs grew urgent, the rotation period became three years.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as frontier emergencies multiplied, the rotation period stretched to three years.

sentences.zh: 軍士日久疲罷，又益選軍余防冬，家有五六人在邊者，軍用重困。

translations.literal: The soldiers grew exhausted over time, and additional reserves were selected for winter defense; in some households five or six men were serving on the frontier, and military expenses became severely burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers grew worn down over time, and additional reserves were drafted for winter defense; in some households five or six men were serving on the frontier at once, and military costs became crushing.

sentences.zh: 驥請歲一更，當代者以十月至，而代者留至來年正月乃遣歸，邊備足而軍不勞。

translations.literal: Ji requested annual rotation: those being replaced would arrive in the tenth month, and the replacements would remain until the first month of the following year before being sent home, so that frontier defenses would be adequate while the troops would not be overstrained.
translations.idiomatic: Ji proposed annual rotation: incoming replacements would arrive in the tenth month, and outgoing troops would remain until the first month of the following year before returning home, keeping the frontier adequately manned without overtaxing the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 帝善其議，行之諸邊。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his proposal and implemented it on all frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the proposal and applied it across all frontier regions.

sentences.zh: 當是時，緬人已以思任發來獻，而思機發竊駐孟養地，屢遣使入貢謝罪。

translations.literal: At that time, the Burmese had already sent Si Renfa as tribute, while Si Jifa secretly remained in Mengyang territory and repeatedly dispatched envoys to present tribute and beg forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Burmese had already delivered Si Renfa to the court, while Si Jifa remained hidden in Mengyang and repeatedly sent envoys to present tribute and beg forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 中外咸願罷兵。

translations.literal: Both within and outside the court, all wished to halt the war.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the court, everyone wanted the war to end.

sentences.zh: 振意終未慊，要思機發躬入朝謝。

translations.literal: Zhen's mind was still not satisfied; he insisted that Si Jifa come in person to court to beg forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen remained unsatisfied and insisted that Si Jifa come to court in person to beg forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 沐斌帥師至金沙江招之，不至。

translations.literal: Mu Bin led troops to the Jinsha River to summon him, but he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Bin led troops to the Jinsha River to summon him, but Si Jifa did not come.

sentences.zh: 諭孟養執之以獻，亦不聽命。

translations.literal: Mengyang was ordered to seize him and present him as tribute, but it also refused to obey.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang was ordered to seize him and deliver him to the court, but it too refused.

sentences.zh: 於是振怒，欲盡滅其種類。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhen grew angry and wished to exterminate their entire people.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen then flew into a rage and wanted to exterminate them entirely.

sentences.zh: 十三年春復命驥總督軍務，宮聚為平蠻將軍，帥師十五萬人往。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year, Ji was again appointed overall commander of military affairs, with Gong Ju as General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, and they led an army of one hundred fifty thousand men on the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirteenth year, Ji was again made overall commander, with Gong Ju as General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, and they marched with one hundred fifty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 明年造舟浮金沙江，蠻人柵西岸拒守。

translations.literal: The following year they built boats to float down the Jinsha River; the barbarians built stockades on the western bank to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they built boats to descend the Jinsha River, while the barbarians fortified the western bank to block them.

sentences.zh: 官軍聯舟為浮橋以濟，拔其柵，進破鬼哭山，連下十余寨，墜溺死者無算。

translations.literal: The imperial army linked boats into a floating bridge to cross, captured the stockades, advanced and broke through Guikushan, and successively took more than ten stockades; countless men fell or drowned to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army linked boats into a floating bridge to cross, stormed the stockades, broke through Guikushan, and took more than ten stockades in succession; countless men fell or drowned.

sentences.zh: 而思機發終脫去，不可得。

translations.literal: Yet Si Jifa ultimately escaped and could not be captured.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Si Jifa ultimately escaped and could not be taken.

sentences.zh: 是時，官軍逾孟養。

translations.literal: At that time, the imperial army advanced beyond Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: By then the imperial army had pushed beyond Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 至孟冉阝海。

translations.literal: They reached Mengruanhai.
translations.idiomatic: They reached Mengruanhai.

sentences.zh: 地在金沙江西，去麓川千里，自古兵力所不至，諸蠻見大軍皆震怖。

translations.literal: The place lay west of the Jinsha River, a thousand li from Luchuan, where imperial forces had never reached since antiquity; all the barbarian tribes were awestruck and terrified at the sight of the main army.
translations.idiomatic: The place lay west of the Jinsha River, a thousand li from Luchuan, where no imperial army had ever penetrated; every barbarian tribe was awestruck and terrified at the sight of the main force.

sentences.zh: 而大軍遠涉，驥慮饋餉不繼，亟謀引還。

translations.literal: But the main army had marched far, and Ji feared that supplies would not keep up; he urgently planned to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: But the army had marched deep into hostile territory, and Ji, fearing that supplies would run out, urgently planned to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 時思機發雖遁匿，而思任發少子思陸復擁眾據孟養。

translations.literal: At that time, although Si Jifa was in hiding, Si Renfa's youngest son Si Lu again gathered forces and held Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Although Si Jifa remained in hiding, Si Renfa's youngest son Si Lu had rallied forces and held Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 驥度賊終不可滅，乃與思陸約，立石表，誓金沙江上，曰：「石爛江枯，爾乃得渡。」

translations.literal: Ji judged that the rebels could never be utterly destroyed; he therefore made a pact with Si Lu, erected a stone tablet, and swore an oath on the Jinsha River, saying: "Only when the stone rots and the river runs dry may you cross.
translations.idiomatic: Ji concluded that the rebels could never be utterly destroyed; he therefore made a pact with Si Lu, set up a stone tablet, and swore an oath on the Jinsha River: "Only when the stone rots and the river runs dry may you cross.

sentences.zh: 遂班師。

translations.literal: Thereupon the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: With that, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 驥凡三征麓川，卒不得思機發。

translations.literal: Ji campaigned against Luchuan three times in all but ultimately failed to capture Si Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: Ji led three campaigns against Luchuan in all but never captured Si Jifa.

sentences.zh: 議者咎驥等老師費財，以一隅騷動天下。

translations.literal: Critics blamed Ji and others for keeping the army in the field too long and wasting resources, stirring up the whole empire over a single corner of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Critics blamed Ji and his colleagues for keeping the army in the field too long and wasting resources, disturbing the entire empire over a single remote corner.

sentences.zh: 而會川衛訓導詹英抗疏劾之，大略謂：「驥等多役民夫，舁彩繒，散諸土司以邀厚利。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Huichuan Guard Instructor Zhan Ying submitted a bold memorial impeaching them, stating in general terms: "Ji and others repeatedly conscripted laborers to carry colored silks and distributed them among the native chieftains to seek large profits.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Huichuan Guard Instructor Zhan Ying submitted a bold memorial impeaching them, charging in general that Ji and his colleagues repeatedly conscripted laborers to carry colored silks and distributed them among the native chieftains to reap large profits.

sentences.zh: 擅用腐刑，詭言進禦，實充私役。

translations.literal: They arbitrarily applied castration, falsely claiming the victims were being presented to the emperor, when in fact they were used as private servants.
translations.idiomatic: They arbitrarily applied castration, falsely claiming the victims were being presented to the emperor when in fact they were kept as private servants.

sentences.zh: 師行無紀，十五萬人一日起行，互相蹂踐。

translations.literal: The army marched without discipline; one hundred fifty thousand men set out on a single day and trampled one another.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched without discipline; when one hundred fifty thousand men set out on a single day, they trampled one another.

sentences.zh: 每軍負米六斗，跋陟山谷，自縊者多。

translations.literal: Each soldier carried six dou of rice, trudging over mountains and valleys; many hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Each soldier carried six dou of rice over mountains and valleys; many hanged themselves along the way.

sentences.zh: 抵金沙江，徬徨不敢渡；

translations.literal: When they reached the Jinsha River, they hesitated and dared not cross;
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the Jinsha River, they hesitated and dared not cross;

sentences.zh: 既渡不敢攻；

translations.literal: after crossing, they dared not attack;
translations.idiomatic: after crossing, they dared not attack;

sentences.zh: 攻而失都指揮路宣、翟亨等。

translations.literal: when they did attack, they lost Commanders Lu Xuan, Zhai Heng, and others.
translations.idiomatic: when they did attack, they lost Commanders Lu Xuan, Zhai Heng, and others.

sentences.zh: 俟賊解，多捕魚戶為俘。

translations.literal: When the rebels dispersed, they captured many fishermen and passed them off as prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels dispersed, they captured many fishermen and passed them off as prisoners of war.

sentences.zh: 以地分木邦、緬甸，掩敗為功。

translations.literal: They divided territory between Mubang and Burma and disguised defeat as victory.
translations.idiomatic: They divided territory between Mubang and Burma and disguised defeat as victory.

sentences.zh: 此何異李宓之敗，而楊國忠以捷聞也。」

translations.literal: How is this any different from Li Mi's defeat, of which Yang Guozhong reported a victory?
translations.idiomatic: How is this any different from Li Mi's defeat, which Yang Guozhong reported as a victory?

sentences.zh: 奏下法司。

translations.literal: The memorial was referred to the judicial authorities.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the judicial authorities.

sentences.zh: 王振左右之，得不問。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen's partisans intervened on their behalf, and the case was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen's partisans intervened, and the case was dropped.

sentences.zh: 而命英從驥軍自效。

translations.literal: Ying was instead ordered to join Ji's army and prove himself in service.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was instead ordered to join Ji's army and prove himself in service.

sentences.zh: 英知往且獲罪，匿不去。

translations.literal: Ying knew that if he went he would be punished, so he hid and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Ying knew that if he went he would be punished, so he went into hiding and refused to go.

sentences.zh: 當是時，湖廣、貴州諸苗，所在蜂起，圍平越及諸城堡，貴州東路閉。

translations.literal: At that time, the Miao tribes of Huguang and Guizhou rose up everywhere like swarming bees, besieging Pingyue and other fortresses, and the eastern route into Guizhou was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Miao tribes of Huguang and Guizhou rose up everywhere, besieging Pingyue and other fortresses and cutting off the eastern route into Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 驥至武昌，詔還軍討苗。

translations.literal: When Ji reached Wuchang, an edict ordered him to turn back and suppress the Miao.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji reached Wuchang, an edict ordered him to turn back and suppress the Miao.

sentences.zh: 會英宗北狩，群臣劾王振並及驥。

translations.literal: Just then Emperor Yingzong was taken north on campaign, and the court officials impeached Wang Zhen and also implicated Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Emperor Yingzong was captured on the northern campaign, and the court officials impeached Wang Zhen and also implicated Ji.

sentences.zh: 以驥方在軍，且倚之平苗，置弗問。

translations.literal: Because Ji was still in the field and the court relied on him to pacify the Miao, the matter was set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ji was still in the field and the court relied on him to pacify the Miao, the matter was set aside.

sentences.zh: 命佩平蠻將軍印，充總兵官，侍郎侯琎總督軍務。

translations.literal: He was ordered to wear the seal of General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, serve as overall commander, and Vice Minister Hou Jin was made overall supervisor of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to wear the seal of General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and serve as overall commander, while Vice Minister Hou Jin was made overall supervisor of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 已而苗益熾，眾至十余萬。

translations.literal: Before long the Miao grew stronger still, their numbers reaching more than one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Miao grew stronger still, their numbers swelling to more than one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 平越被圍半歲，巡按御史黃鎬死守，糧盡掘草根食之，而驥頓軍辰、沅不進。

translations.literal: Pingyue was besieged for half a year; Investigating Censor Huang Hao held out in a desperate defense, and when provisions ran out he dug up grass roots to eat; yet Ji halted his army at Chen and Yuan and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyue was besieged for half a year; Investigating Censor Huang Hao held out in a desperate defense, digging up grass roots to eat when provisions ran out, while Ji halted his army at Chen and Yuan and did not advance.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年，鎬草疏置竹筒中，募人自間道出，聞於朝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingtai, Hao drafted a memorial, placed it in a bamboo tube, and hired a man to carry it out by a hidden route; the news reached the court.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 1 (1450), Hao drafted a memorial, sealed it in a bamboo tube, and hired a courier to carry it out by a hidden route; the news reached the court.

sentences.zh: 更命保定伯梁缶為平蠻將軍，益兵二萬人。

translations.literal: Liang Fu, Earl of Baoding, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians in his place, and twenty thousand additional troops were sent.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Fu, Earl of Baoding, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians in his place, with twenty thousand additional troops.

sentences.zh: 侯琎自雲南督之前，疾戰，大破賊，盡解諸城圍。

translations.literal: Hou Jin advanced from Yunnan under his command, fought fiercely, routed the rebels in a great victory, and lifted the sieges of all the cities.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jin advanced from Yunnan under his command, fought fiercely, routed the rebels, and lifted the sieges of all the cities.

sentences.zh: 而驥亦俘刬平王蟲富等以獻。

translations.literal: Ji also captured and executed Wang Chongfu and others and presented them as trophies.
translations.idiomatic: Ji also captured and executed Wang Chongfu and others and presented them to the court.

sentences.zh: 驥還，命總督南京機務。

translations.literal: When Ji returned, he was appointed overall supervisor of Nanjing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji returned, he was appointed overall supervisor of Nanjing affairs.

sentences.zh: 其冬，乞世券，與之。

translations.literal: That winter he requested a hereditary patent of nobility, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he requested a hereditary patent of nobility, and it was granted.

sentences.zh: 南畿軍素偷惰。

translations.literal: The troops of the southern capital region had long been slack and indolent.
translations.idiomatic: The troops of the southern capital region had long been slack and indolent.

sentences.zh: 驥至，以所馭軍法教之。

translations.literal: When Ji arrived, he trained them according to the military discipline he had used with his own troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji arrived, he trained them according to the military discipline he had used with his own troops.

sentences.zh: 于謙弗重也，朝廷以其舊臣寵禮之。

translations.literal: Yu Qian did not hold him in high regard, but the court treated him with favor as a veteran minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qian did not hold him in high regard, but the court treated him with favor as a veteran minister.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，賜敕解任，奉朝請。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, he was granted an edict releasing him from office and was given the status of a court attendee.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, he was granted an edict releasing him from office and given the status of a court attendee.

sentences.zh: 驥年七十余，躍馬食肉，盛聲伎如故。

translations.literal: Ji was in his seventies, yet he still leapt onto horseback, ate meat heartily, and kept a full retinue of musicians and entertainers as before.
translations.idiomatic: Though in his seventies, Ji still leapt onto horseback, ate meat heartily, and kept a full retinue of musicians and entertainers as before.

sentences.zh: 久之，石亨、徐有貞等奉英宗復辟，驥與謀。

translations.literal: After some time, Shi Heng, Xu Youzhen, and others restored Emperor Yingzong to the throne; Ji took part in the plot.
translations.idiomatic: After a time, Shi Heng, Xu Youzhen, and others restored Emperor Yingzong to the throne, and Ji took part in the plot.

sentences.zh: 賞稍後，上章自訟，言：「臣子祥入南城，為諸將所擠，墮地幾死。

translations.literal: When rewards came late, he submitted a memorial pleading his own case, saying: "My son Xiang entered the Southern City and was jostled by the generals, falling to the ground and nearly dying.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards came late, he submitted a memorial pleading his own case: "My son Xiang entered the Southern City and was jostled by the generals, falling to the ground and nearly dying.

sentences.zh: 今論功不及，疑有蔽之者。」

translations.literal: Now in the distribution of merit he has been passed over; I suspect someone has concealed the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Now in the distribution of merit he has been passed over; I suspect someone has concealed the facts.

sentences.zh: 帝乃官祥指揮僉事。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon appointed Xiang Assistant Commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon appointed Xiang Assistant Commander.

sentences.zh: 而命驥仍兵部尚書，理部事，加號奉天翊衛推誠宣力守正文臣、光祿大夫，余如故。

translations.literal: Ji was ordered to resume his post as Minister of War and manage the affairs of the ministry, and was granted the additional titles of Civil Minister Who Supports Heaven, Guards the Throne, Promotes Sincerity, Displays Strength, and Upholds Integrity, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; his other honors remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was ordered to resume his post as Minister of War and manage the affairs of the ministry, and was granted the additional titles of Civil Minister Who Supports Heaven, Guards the Throne, Promotes Sincerity, Displays Strength, and Upholds Integrity, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; his other honors remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 數月請老，又三年乃卒，年八十三。

translations.literal: After several months he requested retirement; three years later he died at the age of eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: After several months he requested retirement; three years later he died at the age of eighty-three.

sentences.zh: 贈靖遠侯，謚忠毅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Jingyuan and given the posthumous name Zhongyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Jingyuan and given the posthumous name Loyal and Resolute.

sentences.zh: 傳子常及孫添。

translations.literal: The title passed to his son Chang and then to his grandson Tian.
translations.idiomatic: The title passed to his son Chang and then to his grandson Tian.

sentences.zh: 添尚嘉善長公主。

translations.literal: Tian married the eldest princess of Jiashan.
translations.idiomatic: Tian married the eldest princess of Jiashan.

sentences.zh: 再傳至孫瑾。

translations.literal: The title passed down again to Sun Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The title passed down again to Sun Jin.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，提督三千營，協守南京，還掌左府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiajing reign, he supervised the Three Thousand Battalions, assisted in the defense of Nanjing, and later took charge of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiajing reign, he supervised the Three Thousand Battalions, assisted in the defense of Nanjing, and later took charge of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 久之，佩征蠻將軍印，鎮兩廣。

translations.literal: After some time, he wore the seal of General Who Subdues the Barbarians and was stationed in the two Guang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: After a time, he wore the seal of General Who Subdues the Barbarians and was stationed in the two Guang provinces.

sentences.zh: 廣東新寧、新興、思平間多高山叢箐，亡命者輒入諸瑤中，吏不得問，眾至萬余人，流劫高要、陽江諸縣。

translations.literal: Between Xinning, Xinxing, and Siping in Guangdong there were many high mountains and dense bamboo groves; fugitives would flee into the Yao tribes, where officials could not pursue them; their numbers reached more than ten thousand, and they raided Gaoyao, Yangjiang, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Between Xinning, Xinxing, and Siping in Guangdong lay many high mountains and dense bamboo groves; fugitives fled into the Yao tribes beyond official reach, their numbers swelling to more than ten thousand as they raided Gaoyao, Yangjiang, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 官軍討之，輒失利。

translations.literal: Whenever the government troops went to suppress them, they met with defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever government troops went to suppress them, they met with defeat.

sentences.zh: 三十五年春，瑾與巡撫都御史談愷檄諸路土兵誅其魁陳以明，悉平諸巢。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-fifth year, Jin and Grand Coordinator Tan Kai issued orders to the native troops of the various routes to execute their leader Chen Yiming and completely pacified all the strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-fifth year, Jin and Grand Coordinator Tan Kai mobilized native troops from the various routes to execute the rebel leader Chen Yiming and completely pacified all the strongholds.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory arrived, he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 而扶藜、葵梅諸山峒馮天恩等，據險為寇者亦數十年。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Feng Tian'en and others in the mountain stockades of Fuli, Kuimei, and elsewhere had held difficult terrain and raided as bandits for decades.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Feng Tian'en and others in the mountain stockades of Fuli, Kuimei, and elsewhere had held difficult terrain and raided as bandits for decades.

sentences.zh: 瑾復督軍分道進剿，破巢二百余，復以功蔭一子錦衣百戶。

translations.literal: Jin again directed the army in a multi-pronged advance, destroyed more than two hundred strongholds, and was granted the privilege of ennobling one son as a hundred-household commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Jin again directed the army in a multi-pronged advance, destroyed more than two hundred strongholds, and was granted the privilege of ennobling one son as a hundred-household commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 言官劾其暴橫，召還。

translations.literal: Censorial officials impeached him for brutality and tyranny, and he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials impeached him for brutality and tyranny, and he was recalled.

sentences.zh: 爵傳至明亡乃絕。

translations.literal: The noble title continued until the fall of the Ming dynasty, when it became extinct.
translations.idiomatic: The noble title continued until the fall of the Ming dynasty, when it became extinct.

sentences.zh: 徐有貞，字元玉，初名呈，吳人。

translations.literal: Xu Youzhen, styled Yuanyu, originally named Cheng, was a native of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Youzhen, courtesy name Yuanyu, originally named Cheng, came from Wu.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eighth year of the Xuande reign.
translations.idiomatic: He placed among the metropolitan graduates in Xuande 8 (1433).

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 為人短小精悍，多智數，喜功名。

translations.literal: By nature he was short in stature but sharp and vigorous, full of stratagems, and eager for fame and achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Short in stature but sharp and vigorous, he was full of stratagems and eager for fame and achievement.

sentences.zh: 凡天官、地理、兵法、水利、陰陽方術之書，無不諳究。

translations.literal: He was thoroughly versed in every book on astronomy, geography, military strategy, water control, and yin-yang occult arts.
translations.idiomatic: He was thoroughly versed in every book on astronomy, geography, military strategy, water control, and yin-yang occult arts.

sentences.zh: 時承平既久，邊備俞惰，而西南用兵不息，呈以為憂。

translations.literal: At that time peace had lasted long, frontier defenses grew ever more slack, and warfare in the southwest never ceased; Cheng regarded this with alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Peace had lasted so long that frontier defenses grew ever more slack, while warfare in the southwest never ceased; Cheng regarded this with alarm.

sentences.zh: 正統七年疏陳兵政五事，帝善之而不能用。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengtong he submitted a memorial setting forth five points on military administration; the emperor approved them but could not implement them.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 7 (1442), he submitted a memorial setting forth five points on military administration; the emperor approved them but could not implement them.

sentences.zh: 十二年進侍講。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Hanlin Reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Hanlin Reader.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourteenth year, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 呈私語友人劉溥曰「禍不遠矣」，亟命妻子南還。

translations.literal: Cheng privately told his friend Liu Pu, "Disaster is not far off," and urgently ordered his wife and children to return south.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng privately told his friend Liu Pu, "Disaster is not far off," and urgently sent his wife and children back south.

sentences.zh: 及土木難作，郕王召廷臣問計。

translations.literal: When the Tumu disaster occurred, the Prince of Cheng summoned the court officials to discuss strategy.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tumu disaster occurred, the Prince of Cheng summoned the court officials to discuss strategy.

sentences.zh: 呈大言曰：「驗之星象，稽之歷數，天命已去，惟南遷可以紓難。」

translations.literal: Cheng spoke boldly, saying: "Examining the stars and calculating the cycles of fate, the Mandate of Heaven has departed; only moving the capital south can relieve the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng spoke boldly: "Examining the stars and calculating the cycles of fate, the Mandate of Heaven has departed; only moving the capital south can relieve the crisis.

sentences.zh: 太監金英叱之，胡濙、陳循咸執不可。

translations.literal: The eunuch Jin Ying rebuked him, and Hu Ying and Chen Xun both insisted it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Jin Ying rebuked him, and Hu Ying and Chen Xun both insisted it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎于謙曰：「言南遷者，可斬也。」

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Yu Qian said: "Whoever speaks of moving the capital south deserves execution.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of War Yu Qian said: "Whoever speaks of moving the capital south deserves execution.

sentences.zh: 呈大沮，不敢復言。

translations.literal: Cheng was greatly discouraged and dared not speak again.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was greatly discouraged and dared not speak again.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年遷右諭德。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai he was transferred to Right Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 3 (1452), he was transferred to Right Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 河決沙灣七載，前後治者皆無功。

translations.literal: The Yellow River had breached its banks at Shawan for seven years, and all previous efforts to control it had failed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River had breached its banks at Shawan for seven years, and all previous efforts to control it had failed.

sentences.zh: 廷臣共舉有貞，乃擢左僉都御史，治之。

translations.literal: The court officials jointly recommended Youzhen, and he was promoted to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief to manage the project.
translations.idiomatic: The court officials jointly recommended Youzhen, and he was promoted to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief to manage the project.

sentences.zh: 至張秋，相度水勢，條上三策：一置水門，一開支河，一浚運河。

translations.literal: When he reached Zhangqiu, he surveyed the water conditions and submitted three proposals in detail: first, to install sluice gates; second, to open branch channels; third, to dredge the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Zhangqiu, he surveyed the water conditions and submitted three detailed proposals: install sluice gates, open branch channels, and dredge the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 議既定，督漕都御史王竑以漕渠淤淺滯運艘，請急塞決口。

translations.literal: Once the plan was settled, Grain Transport Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong, citing the silted and shallow transport channels that delayed grain barges, requested urgent closure of the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Once the plan was settled, Grain Transport Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong, citing the silted and shallow transport channels that delayed grain barges, requested urgent closure of the breach.

sentences.zh: 帝敕有貞如軏議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Youzhen to follow Wang's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Youzhen to follow Wang's proposal.

sentences.zh: 有貞守便宜。

translations.literal: Youzhen insisted on acting at his own discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen insisted on acting at his own discretion.

sentences.zh: 言：「臨清河淺，舊矣，非因決口未塞也。

translations.literal: He said: "The shallowness of the river at Linqing is an old problem and is not caused by the breach remaining unclosed.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "The shallowness of the river at Linqing is an old problem and is not caused by the breach remaining unclosed.

sentences.zh: 漕臣但知塞決口為急，不知秋冬雖塞，來春必復決，徒勞無益。

translations.literal: The grain transport officials know only that closing the breach is urgent, but do not realize that even if it is closed in autumn and winter, it will breach again in the coming spring, making the effort futile.
translations.idiomatic: The grain transport officials know only that closing the breach is urgent, but do not realize that even if it is closed in autumn and winter, it will breach again in the coming spring, making the effort futile.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢邀近功。」

translations.literal: Your servant dares not seek quick results.
translations.idiomatic: I dare not seek quick results.

sentences.zh: 詔從其言。

translations.literal: An edict approved his view.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his view.

sentences.zh: 有貞於是大集民夫，躬親督率，治渠建閘，起張秋以接河、沁。

translations.literal: Youzhen thereupon mobilized a great force of laborers, personally supervised the work, dredged channels and built sluice gates, and extended the works from Zhangqiu to connect with the Yellow and Qin Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen thereupon mobilized a great force of laborers, personally supervised the work, dredged channels and built sluice gates, and extended the works from Zhangqiu to connect with the Yellow and Qin Rivers.

sentences.zh: 河流之旁出不順者，為九堰障之。

translations.literal: Where the river branched out irregularly, nine weirs were built to block it.
translations.idiomatic: Where the river branched out irregularly, nine weirs were built to block it.

sentences.zh: 更築大堰，楗以水門，閱五百五十五日而工成。

translations.literal: He further built a great weir and fitted it with sluice gates; after five hundred fifty-five days the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: He further built a great weir fitted with sluice gates; after five hundred fifty-five days the work was completed.

sentences.zh: 名其渠曰「廣濟」，閘曰「通源」。

translations.literal: He named the channel "Broad Relief" and the sluice "Source Access."
translations.idiomatic: He named the channel Broad Relief and the sluice Source Access.

sentences.zh: 方工之未成也，帝以轉漕為急，工部尚書江淵等請遣中書偕文武大臣督京軍五萬人往助役，期三月畢工。

translations.literal: While the work was still unfinished, the emperor, anxious about grain transport, had Minister of Works Jiang Yuan and others request that a Secretariat Director be sent with civil and military grandees to supervise fifty thousand capital troops to assist in the labor, with completion expected in three months.
translations.idiomatic: While the work was still unfinished, the emperor, anxious about grain transport, had Minister of Works Jiang Yuan and others request that a Secretariat Director be sent with civil and military grandees to supervise fifty thousand capital troops to assist in the labor, with completion expected in three months.

sentences.zh: 有貞言：「京軍一出，日費不貲，遇漲則束手坐視，無所施力。

translations.literal: Youzhen said: "Once the capital troops are sent out, daily expenses will be incalculable; when floods rise they can only sit idle and watch, unable to do anything.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen said: "Once the capital troops are sent out, daily expenses will be incalculable; when floods rise they can only sit idle and watch, unable to do anything.

sentences.zh: 今泄口已合，決堤已堅，但用沿河民夫，自足集事。」

translations.literal: Now the outflow has been closed and the breached dike has been strengthened; laborers from along the river alone will suffice to complete the task.
translations.idiomatic: Now the outflow has been closed and the breached dike has been strengthened; laborers from along the river alone will suffice to complete the task.

sentences.zh: 議遂寢。

translations.literal: The proposal was thereupon dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was thereupon dropped.

sentences.zh: 事竣，召還，佐院事。

translations.literal: When the work was finished, he was recalled to assist in the affairs of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished, he was recalled to assist in the affairs of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 帝厚勞之。

translations.literal: The emperor richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor richly rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 復出巡視漕河。

translations.literal: He was again sent out to inspect the transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent out to inspect the transport canal.

sentences.zh: 濟守十三州縣河夫多負官馬及他雜辦，所司趣之亟，有貞為言免之。

translations.literal: In the thirteen prefectures and counties under Ji Prefecture, many canal laborers owed debts for official horses and other miscellaneous obligations; the authorities pressed them urgently, and Youzhen interceded to have the debts remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteen prefectures and counties under Ji Prefecture, many canal laborers owed debts for official horses and other miscellaneous obligations; the authorities pressed them urgently, and Youzhen interceded to have the debts remitted.

sentences.zh: 七年秋，山東大水，河堤多壞，惟有貞所築如故。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the seventh year, Shandong suffered great floods and many river dikes were destroyed, but those built by Youzhen remained intact.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the seventh year, Shandong suffered great floods and many river dikes were destroyed, but those built by Youzhen remained intact.

sentences.zh: 有貞乃修舊堤決口，自臨清抵濟寧，各置減水閘，水患悉平。

translations.literal: Youzhen then repaired the old dikes at the breach points, and from Linqing to Jining installed flood-release sluices at each location; all water disasters were thereby resolved.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen then repaired the old dikes at the breach points and installed flood-release sluices from Linqing to Jining; all flooding was thereby brought under control.

sentences.zh: 還朝，帝召見，獎勞有加，進左副都御史。

translations.literal: On returning to court, he was summoned for an audience; the emperor praised and rewarded him generously and promoted him to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court, he was summoned for an audience; the emperor praised and rewarded him generously and promoted him to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，景帝不豫。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, Emperor Jing was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, Emperor Jing fell ill.

sentences.zh: 石亨、張輒等謀迎上皇，以告太常卿許彬。

translations.literal: Shi Heng, Zhang Er, and others plotted to welcome back the former emperor and told Minister of Ceremonies Xu Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Heng, Zhang Er, and others plotted to welcome back the former emperor and confided in Minister of Ceremonies Xu Bin.

sentences.zh: 彬曰：「此不世功也。

translations.literal: Bin said: "This is an achievement without parallel in the age.
translations.idiomatic: Bin said: "This is an achievement without parallel in the age.

sentences.zh: 彬老矣，無能為。

translations.literal: Bin is old and can do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: I am old and can do nothing.

sentences.zh: 徐元玉善奇策，盍與圖之。」

translations.literal: Xu Yuanyu is skilled in bold stratagems; why not consult him on this?
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yuanyu is skilled in bold stratagems; why not consult him on this?

sentences.zh: 亨即夜至有貞家。

translations.literal: That very night Heng went to Youzhen's house.
translations.idiomatic: That very night Heng went to Youzhen's house.

sentences.zh: 聞之，大喜，曰：「須令南城知此意。」

translations.literal: When Youzhen heard of it, he was greatly pleased and said: "The Southern City must be made aware of this plan.
translations.idiomatic: When Youzhen heard of it, he was greatly pleased and said: "The Southern City must be made aware of this plan.

sentences.zh: 軏曰：「陰達之矣。」

translations.literal: Er said: "It has already been conveyed in secret."
translations.idiomatic: Er said: "It has already been conveyed in secret."

sentences.zh: 令太監曹吉祥入白太后。

translations.literal: They ordered the eunuch Cao Jixiang to enter and inform the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered the eunuch Cao Jixiang to enter and inform the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛巳夜，諸人復會有貞所。

translations.literal: On the night of xinsi, the conspirators gathered again at Youzhen's house.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinsi, the conspirators gathered again at Youzhen's house.

sentences.zh: 有貞升屋覽乾象，亟下曰：「時至矣，勿失。」

translations.literal: Youzhen climbed onto the roof to observe the celestial signs, then hurried down and said: "The time has come; do not miss it.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen climbed onto the roof to observe the celestial signs, then hurried down and said: "The time has come; do not miss it.

sentences.zh: 時方有邊警，有貞令軏詭言備非常，勒兵入大內。

translations.literal: At that time there was an alarm on the frontier; Youzhen had Er falsely claim that extraordinary measures were needed and led the troops into the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was an alarm on the frontier; Youzhen had Er falsely claim that extraordinary measures were needed and led the troops into the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 亨掌門鑰，夜四鼓，開長安門納之。

translations.literal: Heng held the gate keys; at the fourth watch of the night he opened Chang'an Gate and admitted them.
translations.idiomatic: Heng held the gate keys; at the fourth watch of the night he opened Chang'an Gate and admitted them.

sentences.zh: 既入，復閉以遏外兵。

translations.literal: Once inside, they closed the gate again to block outside troops.
translations.idiomatic: Once inside, they closed the gate again to block outside troops.

sentences.zh: 時天色晦冥，亨、軏皆惶惑，謂有貞曰：「事當濟否？」

translations.literal: The sky was dark and murky; Heng and Er were both fearful and confused, and asked Youzhen: "Will the affair succeed?
translations.idiomatic: The sky was dark and murky; Heng and Er were both fearful and confused, and asked Youzhen: "Will the affair succeed?

sentences.zh: 有貞大言「必濟」，趣之行。

translations.literal: Youzhen declared loudly that it would surely succeed and urged them onward.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen declared loudly that it would surely succeed and urged them onward.

sentences.zh: 既薄南城，門錮，毀墻以入。

translations.literal: When they reached the Southern City, the gate was locked, so they broke through the wall to enter.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the Southern City, the gate was locked, so they broke through the wall to enter.

sentences.zh: 上皇燈下獨出問故，有貞等俯伏請登位，乃呼進輿。

translations.literal: The former emperor came out alone by lamplight to ask the reason; Youzhen and the others prostrated themselves and begged him to take the throne, then called for the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: The former emperor came out alone by lamplight to ask the reason; Youzhen and the others prostrated themselves and begged him to take the throne, then called for the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 兵士惶懼不能舉，有貞率諸人助挽以行。

translations.literal: The soldiers were too fearful to lift it; Youzhen led the others in helping to push it along.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers were too fearful to lift it; Youzhen led the others in helping to push it along.

sentences.zh: 星月忽開朗，上皇各問諸人姓名。

translations.literal: The stars and moon suddenly cleared, and the former emperor asked each man his name.
translations.idiomatic: The stars and moon suddenly cleared, and the former emperor asked each man his name.

sentences.zh: 至東華門，門者拒弗納，上皇曰「朕太上皇帝也」，遂反走。

translations.literal: At Donghua Gate the guards refused to admit them; the former emperor said, "I am the Retired Emperor," and they turned back.
translations.idiomatic: At Donghua Gate the guards refused to admit them; the former emperor said, "I am the Retired Emperor," and they turned back.

sentences.zh: 乃升奉天門，有貞等常服謁賀，呼「萬歲」。

translations.literal: They then ascended Fengtian Gate; Youzhen and the others, in ordinary dress, paid homage and cried "Long live the emperor!"
translations.idiomatic: They then ascended Fengtian Gate; Youzhen and the others, in ordinary dress, paid homage and cried "Long live the emperor!"

sentences.zh: 景帝明當視朝，群臣咸待漏闕下。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing was due to hold court at dawn; all the officials waited below the palace gate for the water clock to signal the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing was due to hold court at dawn; all the officials waited below the palace gate for the water clock to signal the hour.

sentences.zh: 忽聞殿中呼噪聲，方驚愕。

translations.literal: Suddenly they heard shouting and clamor in the hall and were startled.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly they heard shouting and clamor in the hall and were startled.

sentences.zh: 俄諸門畢啟，有貞出號於眾曰：「太上皇帝復位矣！」

translations.literal: Soon all the gates opened, and Youzhen came out and proclaimed to the crowd: "The Retired Emperor has been restored to the throne!
translations.idiomatic: Soon all the gates opened, and Youzhen came out and proclaimed to the crowd: "The Retired Emperor has been restored to the throne!

sentences.zh: 趣入賀。

translations.literal: He urged them to enter and offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: He urged them to enter and offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 即日命有貞兼學士，入內閣，參預機務。

translations.literal: That same day Youzhen was appointed concurrently as Hanlin Academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and participated in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Youzhen was appointed concurrently as Hanlin Academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and participated in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 明日加兵部尚書。

translations.literal: The next day he was additionally appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he was additionally appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 有貞謂亨曰：「願得冠側註從兄後。」

translations.literal: Youzhen said to Heng: "I wish to have a note added beside my title, following my elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen said to Heng: "I wish to have a note added beside my title, following my elder brother.

sentences.zh: 亨為言於帝，封武功伯兼華蓋殿大學士，掌文淵閣事，賜號「奉天翊衛推誠宣力守正文臣」，祿千一百石，世錦衣指揮使，給誥券。

translations.literal: Heng spoke on his behalf to the emperor; Youzhen was enfeoffed as Earl of Wugong and concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Imperial Canopy, managing the affairs of the Pavilion of Literary Sources, granted the title "Civil Minister Who Supports Heaven, Guards the Throne, Promotes Sincerity, Displays Strength, and Upholds Integrity," given a stipend of one thousand one hundred shi, hereditary commandership in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and presented with a patent of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Heng spoke on his behalf to the emperor; Youzhen was enfeoffed as Earl of Wugong and concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Imperial Canopy, managing the affairs of the Pavilion of Literary Sources, granted the title Civil Minister Who Supports Heaven, Guards the Throne, Promotes Sincerity, Displays Strength, and Upholds Integrity, given a stipend of one thousand one hundred shi, hereditary commandership in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and presented with a patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 有貞遂誣少保于謙、大學士王文，殺之。

translations.literal: Youzhen then falsely accused Junior Guardian Yu Qian and Grand Secretary Wang Wen and had them executed.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen then falsely accused Junior Guardian Yu Qian and Grand Secretary Wang Wen and had them executed.

sentences.zh: 內閣諸臣斥遂略盡。

translations.literal: The other members of the Grand Secretariat were driven out almost to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: The other members of the Grand Secretariat were driven out almost to the last man.

sentences.zh: 陳循素有德於有貞，亦弗救也。

translations.literal: Chen Xun, who had long shown kindness to Youzhen, was not spared either.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xun, who had long shown kindness to Youzhen, was not spared either.

sentences.zh: 事權盡歸有貞，中外咸側目。

translations.literal: All power passed to Youzhen, and both within and outside the court people watched him with sidelong glances.
translations.idiomatic: All power passed to Youzhen, and both within and outside the court people watched him with sidelong glances.

sentences.zh: 而有貞愈益發舒，進見無時，帝亦傾心委任。

translations.literal: Yet Youzhen grew ever more unrestrained, appearing before the emperor at all hours, and the emperor also gave him his full trust.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Youzhen grew ever more unrestrained, appearing before the emperor at all hours, and the emperor also gave him his full trust.

sentences.zh: 有貞既得誌，則思自異於曹、石。

translations.literal: Once Youzhen had achieved his ambition, he sought to distinguish himself from Cao and Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Once Youzhen had achieved his ambition, he sought to distinguish himself from Cao and Shi.

sentences.zh: 窺帝於二人不能無厭色，乃稍稍裁之，且微言其貪橫狀，帝亦為之動。

translations.literal: Observing that the emperor could not hide his displeasure with the two men, he gradually reined them in and subtly described their greed and tyranny; the emperor was moved by this as well.
translations.idiomatic: Observing that the emperor could not hide his displeasure with the two men, he gradually reined them in and subtly described their greed and tyranny; the emperor was moved by this as well.

sentences.zh: 御史楊瑄奏劾亨、吉祥侵占民田。

translations.literal: Censor Yang Xuan memorialized impeaching Heng and Jixiang for seizing commoners' farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yang Xuan memorialized impeaching Heng and Jixiang for seizing commoners' farmland.

sentences.zh: 帝問有貞及李賢，皆對如瑄奏。

translations.literal: The emperor asked Youzhen and Li Xian, and both answered as Yang Xuan had stated in his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Youzhen and Li Xian, and both answered as Yang Xuan had stated in his memorial.

sentences.zh: 有詔獎瑄。

translations.literal: An edict was issued praising Yang Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued praising Yang Xuan.

sentences.zh: 亨、吉祥大怨恨，日夜謀構有貞。

translations.literal: Heng and Jixiang were filled with great resentment and plotted day and night to frame Youzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Heng and Jixiang were filled with great resentment and plotted day and night to frame Youzhen.

sentences.zh: 帝方眷有貞，時屏人密語。

translations.literal: The emperor was then favoring Youzhen and often dismissed attendants to speak with him in private.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then favoring Youzhen and often dismissed attendants to speak with him in private.

sentences.zh: 吉祥令小豎竊聽得之，故泄之帝。

translations.literal: Jixiang had a young attendant eavesdrop and learn what was said, then leaked it to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Jixiang had a young attendant eavesdrop and learn what was said, then leaked it to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝驚問曰：「安所受此語？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked in alarm: "Where did you hear this?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked in alarm: "Where did you hear this?

sentences.zh: 對曰：「受之有貞，某日語某事，外間無弗聞。」

translations.literal: He answered: "I heard it from Youzhen; on such-and-such a day he spoke of such-and-such a matter, and nothing of it escaped the outside world."
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "I heard it from Youzhen; on such-and-such a day he spoke of such-and-such a matter, and nothing of it escaped the outside world."

sentences.zh: 帝自是疏有貞。

translations.literal: From then on the emperor kept Youzhen at a distance.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the emperor kept Youzhen at a distance.

sentences.zh: 會御史張鵬等欲糾亨他罪，未上，而給事中王鉉泄之亨、吉祥。

translations.literal: Just then Censor Zhang Peng and others intended to impeach Heng on other charges, but before the memorial was submitted, Supervising Secretary Wang Xuan leaked it to Heng and Jixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Censor Zhang Peng and others intended to impeach Heng on other charges, but before the memorial was submitted, Supervising Secretary Wang Xuan leaked it to Heng and Jixiang.

sentences.zh: 二人乃泣訴於帝，謂內閣實主之。

translations.literal: The two men then wept and complained to the emperor, claiming that the Grand Secretariat was really behind it.
translations.idiomatic: The two men then wept and complained to the emperor, claiming that the Grand Secretariat was really behind it.

sentences.zh: 遂下諸御史獄，並逮系有貞及李賢。

translations.literal: The censors were thereupon thrown into prison, and Youzhen and Li Xian were arrested as well.
translations.idiomatic: The censors were thereupon thrown into prison, and Youzhen and Li Xian were arrested as well.

sentences.zh: 忽雷雹交作，大風折木。

translations.literal: Suddenly thunder and hail struck together, and a great wind snapped trees.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly thunder and hail struck together, and a great wind snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 帝憾悟，重違亨意，乃釋有貞出為廣東參政。

translations.literal: The emperor regretted his action and, unwilling to go against Heng's wishes entirely, released Youzhen and sent him out as Administrative Vice Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor regretted his action and, unwilling to go against Heng's wishes entirely, released Youzhen and sent him out as Administrative Vice Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 亨等憾未已，必欲殺之。

translations.literal: Heng and the others' resentment was not yet spent; they were determined to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Heng and the others' resentment was not yet spent; they were determined to kill him.

sentences.zh: 令人投匿名書，指斥乘輿，雲有貞怨望，使其客馬士權者為之。

translations.literal: They had someone submit an anonymous letter denouncing the imperial carriage, claiming that Youzhen harbored resentment and that his client Ma Shiquan had written it.
translations.idiomatic: They had someone submit an anonymous letter denouncing the imperial carriage, claiming that Youzhen harbored resentment and that his client Ma Shiquan had written it.

sentences.zh: 遂追執有貞於德州，並士權下詔獄，榜治無驗。

translations.literal: Youzhen was then pursued and arrested at Dezhou; he and Shiquan were thrown into the imperial prison and tortured, but no evidence was found.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen was then pursued and arrested at Dezhou; he and Shiquan were thrown into the imperial prison and tortured, but no evidence was found.

sentences.zh: 會承天門災，肆赦。

translations.literal: Just then Chengtian Gate was destroyed by fire, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Chengtian Gate was destroyed by fire, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 亨、吉祥慮有貞見釋，言於帝曰：「有貞自撰武功伯券辭雲『纘禹成功』，又自擇封邑武功。

translations.literal: Heng and Jixiang, fearing that Youzhen would be released, said to the emperor: "Youzhen composed the text for his Earl of Wugong patent himself, writing 'Continuing Yu's achievement,' and also chose Wugong as his fief himself.
translations.idiomatic: Heng and Jixiang, fearing that Youzhen would be released, said to the emperor: "Youzhen composed the text for his Earl of Wugong patent himself, writing 'Continuing Yu's achievement,' and also chose Wugong as his fief himself.

sentences.zh: 禹受禪為帝，武功者曹操始封也。

translations.literal: Yu received the abdication and became emperor; Wugong was the first fief granted to Cao Cao.
translations.idiomatic: Yu received the abdication and became emperor; Wugong was the first fief granted to Cao Cao.

sentences.zh: 有貞誌圖非望。」

translations.literal: Youzhen's ambition aims at unlawful aspirations.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen's ambition aims at unlawful aspirations.

sentences.zh: 帝出以示法司，刑部侍郎劉廣衡等奏當棄市。

translations.literal: The emperor produced this for the judicial authorities; Vice Minister of Justice Liu Guangheng and others memorialized that he should be executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor produced this for the judicial authorities; Vice Minister of Justice Liu Guangheng and others memorialized that he should be executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 詔徙金齒為民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him exiled to Jinchi as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him exiled to Jinchi as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 亨敗，帝從容謂李賢、王翺曰：「徐有貞何大罪？

translations.literal: When Heng fell, the emperor said calmly to Li Xian and Wang Ao: "What great crime did Xu Youzhen commit?
translations.idiomatic: When Heng fell, the emperor said calmly to Li Xian and Wang Ao: "What great crime did Xu Youzhen commit?

sentences.zh: 為石亨輩所陷耳。

translations.literal: He was simply framed by Shi Heng and his ilk.
translations.idiomatic: He was simply framed by Shi Heng and his ilk.

sentences.zh: 其釋歸田裏。」

translations.literal: Release him to return to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: Release him to return to his home district.

sentences.zh: 成化初，復冠帶閑住。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chenghua reign, his cap and belt were restored and he was allowed to live in retirement.
